text_block_list.text: So much for my grand ambitions.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
For all that I strove to demonstrate my
Emperor's
strength, I have nothing to
show for it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You're right. So long as my pride remains

unbroken, the crowd may still place their
hopes in
me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will enter the Arima Kinen... and in that
crucible
of ambitions, I will finally make
my mark.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I know you can do it.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your faith will be the lamp
that lights
my way.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I will continue forth, no matter what

obstacles present themselves before me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As we resolve to fix our sights on the
Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.
Good work out there, Prez.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to
watch me
race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the
strongest
Umamusume was.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Shame about how it turned out. How
does it feel
to be toppled from your
throne?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Surprisingly refreshing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hmph. Putting on a brave face, huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
"The Emperor's Comeback" would make
a rather
good headline, don't you think?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Nothing fazes you, huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you
someday. You
look like an opponent
worth sinking my teeth
into.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can weather
a gentle
nibble.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Эйр Грув
not with
you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to
assume that
she would be watching... Or
could it be that she
has something to
attend to?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really
your speed.
You make it too obvious.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's not what I—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow you if
you don't
keep an eye on her?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Never mind. Anyway, you did good
today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Get yourself some rest. You've earned it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer... About what Brian
just said—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper. Do
you have
a minute?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Just give me a moment to get
ready.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We can pick this up later. The press is
calling.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I am certain they will be excited to hear
what the
Emperor will do following her
defeat.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Симболи Рудольф
winds up
swamped with interviews, and
we never get the
chance to have that
talk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
